title: Bihar BPSC AES 2025 Admit Card 2026 for 17 Post
intro: Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has Officially Released Admit Card for the Post of Assistant Environmental Scientist (AES) under Environment, Forest and Climate Change Dept., Govt. Of Bihar. Recruitment 2025 for 17 Post. Exam Held on June 11, 2026. & Admit Card Released OnJune 4, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Admit Card Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: Online Apply Start On : 27 August 2025
Registration Last Date : 19 September 2025
Fee Payment Last Date : 19 September 2025
Admit Card Available: 04 June 2026
Exam Date : 11 June 2026
All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee Through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking Fee Mode.
Note: Candidates who do not provide their Aadhaar number as an identity proof in the online application will have to pay an additional Biometric fee of Rs.200/-
Minimum Age :  21 Years
Maximum Age : 37 Years (Male)
Maximum Age : 40 Years (Female UR, BC/ EBC-Male & Female)
Maximum Age : 42 Years (SC/ ST-Male & Female)
For Age Relaxation.Read the Official Notification
Age Calculator:  Click Here
A candidate must have a post-graduate degree in Chemistry, Life Science, Environmental Science, or Physics.
Application Process: Candidates who are already employed must submit their application through their current employer.
For More Details, Read Official Notification.
Pay Scale: Initial pay level: 6
Selection Process:Selection on the Basis of Written Exam & Interview.
Paper I: General Studies (100 marks, 2 hours duration)
Paper II: Optional Subject (100 marks, 2 hours duration)
